title: Trie: Count Words with Given Prefix
statement:
Build a Trie and, for each query prefix P, count how many inserted words start with P.

This requires storing at each Trie node the count of words passing through it.
inputFormat:
The first line contains W.
The next W lines each contain a word (duplicates allowed).
The next line contains Q.
The next Q lines each contain a prefix.
outputFormat: Q lines, each the count of inserted words that start with the given prefix.
constraints:
1 <= W <= 10^4
1 <= Q <= 10^4
1 <= |word|, |prefix| <= 20
All words/prefixes are lowercase letters.
